title: Limit of majority Fourier weight
statement: For each odd positive integer $k$, let $W_k(r)$ be the sum of the squared level-$k$ Fourier coefficients of majority on the cube $\{-1,1\}^{k+2r}$, using the uniform measure. As $r\to\infty$, $W_k(r)$ converges to $\frac{2}{\pi}a_k$, where $a_k=\frac{2}{k2^k}\binom{k-1}{(k-1)/2}$.
